title: Maintainer reproduces exact-subject self-application evidence
summary: DEVAI self-application state is regenerated from tracked inputs for one exact subject, and every currentness projection derives from the same canonical mappings and readings.
preconditions: The exact source commit and tree are known
Canonical inventory and score mappings are available

steps.action: Regenerate inventory, readings, and scorecard twice from the same exact subject and tracked inputs
steps.expected_outcome: Both runs produce content-identical exact-subject results

steps.action: Evaluate dashboard currentness and render the aspect grid
steps.expected_outcome: Missing or stale inputs fail currentness, and the grid derives from canonical runtime mapping plus the declared N/A overlay

postconditions: Tracked self-application evidence is reproducible and bound to one exact subject

acceptance_criteria.statement: Inventory, readings, and scorecard are reproducible from tracked inputs for the exact source commit and tree.
Dashboard currentness fails on missing, stale, or differently bound evidence.
The aspect grid derives from the canonical runtime sensor mapping and the repository N/A overlay.
